⚡ **Build on Radiant — in Python.**

Sharing **pyrxd**: an open-source Python SDK for Radiant. If you can write Python, you can build on Radiant — wallets, transactions, Glyph tokens (NFT / FT / dMint), SPV, soulbound covenants, and trustless cross-chain atomic swaps. On PyPI:
```
pip install pyrxd
```
**What you can do:**

🪙 **Tokens & dMint, straight from code.** Mint/transfer NFTs & FTs, and deploy + PoW-mine **dMint V2** — all five difficulty modes (FIXED, ASERT, LWMA, EPOCH, SCHEDULE), byte-matched to canonical Photonic. ✅ **Proven on mainnet:** a real V2 deploy, PoW mint, and on-chain difficulty retarget.

🌉 **Cross-chain across 7 chains, no bridge.** Trustless HTLC atomic swaps: **RXD ↔ Bitcoin, Litecoin, Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum & Linea** — no custodian, no wrapped tokens.

🛡️ **Covenants & soulbound tokens.** Build consensus-enforced **soulbound NFTs**, credential-gated swaps, and your own covenants — with **SPV proof verification** and transaction decoding built in. Radiant's expressive scripting, from Python.

**New here? → the tutorials take you from `pip install` to a token minted on a local chain**, nothing at risk.

pyrxd is open-source, **Apache 2.0**, provided as-is — like Radiant itself. The cross-chain swap stack is unaudited, so verify before moving real value. Feedback + a second set of eyes very welcome.
